title: One module names the store this Fly app serves
evidence: app/lib/store.server.ts holds BRAND_SHOP_DOMAIN, EDU_SHOP_DOMAIN and ownStore() (SHOPIFY_SHOP_DOMAIN, default the brand shop, cross-checked against FLY_APP_NAME since S-17); trending-cron.server.ts reads it for its lock name, admin shop and buildStoreHandleMap branch. No other app/ code reads SHOPIFY_SHOP_DOMAIN or compares against a store domain (admin-shop.server.ts ADMIN_SHOP_DOMAIN is a per-request session check, left alone)
durability_check: app/lib/trending-cron.store-identity.test.ts (brand set / brand unset / edu: lock name + admin shop + handle branch + start log)
